dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The three most prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper-mid dorsal surface exhibit sharp high-intensity perimeters that transition abruptly from the dark exterior base coat to light-colored ring boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical, solid high-intensity pixel clusters located predominantly along the lower lateral flank, lacking internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal region form a scalene triangle with its longest axis oriented longitudinally toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly complex, interconnected reticulated lattice pattern of light-intensity pixels spans approximately 70% of the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
